items.summary: Update the Travel Tools tile currently titled “Print on Demand Travel Products” to display the title exactly as “TravelButts shop”, and make that tile navigate directly to the existing Shop page/route (use the same destination as the app’s current Shop navigation, not the coming-soon page).

Implement one-time view-count initialization for blog posts: when a blog post is opened for the first time and it has no persisted view count yet, set its initial view count to a random integer between 700 and 1000 (inclusive) and persist it; on subsequent opens, increment the persisted view count by exactly 1 per open.
